text: 【吴清：提升资本市场抵御各类“黑天鹅”等风险事件的能力】11月14日，证监会主席吴清在参加2026中国资本市场学术年会时表示，全球资本市场正在经历新一轮的资产再定价、再平衡。这需要积极践行全球治理倡议，深化资本市场监管合作，共同研究应对不确定难预料因素，增强确定性制度供给，不断提升资本市场抵御各类“黑天鹅”“灰犀牛”等重大风险事件的能力和韧性。
text_en: [Wu Qing: Enhance the capital market's ability to withstand various risk events such as "black swans"] On November 14, CSRC Chairman Wu Qing said at the 2026 China Capital Market Academic Annual Meeting that global capital markets are undergoing a new round of asset repricing and rebalancing. This requires actively practicing the global governance initiative, deepening capital market regulatory cooperation, jointly studying how to respond to uncertain and unpredictable factors, enhancing the supply of certainty in institutions, and continuously improving the capital market's ability and resilience to withstand major risk events such as "black swans" and "gray rhinos".
